name: GCP Cloud Storage Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Google Cloud Storage configurations. Covers bucket IAM policies, ACLs, uniform bucket-level access, signed URLs, encryption (CMEK/CSEK), retention policies, and data exposure risks in GCS.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to GCS security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands GCS access control mechanisms and common misconfiguration patterns
evidence: Can explain bucket IAM policies, ACLs, and uniform bucket-level access
Understands GCS encryption options (Google-managed, CMEK, CSEK)
Familiar with common GCS data exposure patterns

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Enumerates and reviews GCS configurations under supervision
evidence: Uses tools to scan for publicly accessible buckets and objects
Reviews bucket policies for overly permissive access under guidance
Documents GCS security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses GCS security posture across projects
evidence: Independently identifies misconfigured bucket policies and public access
Evaluates cross-project GCS access and signed URL risks
Assesses encryption, logging, and retention configurations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex GCS security scenarios including cross-project data flows and exfiltration simulation
evidence: Identifies subtle data exposure through signed URL abuse and cross-project IAM
Develops automated GCS configuration audit tooling
Reviews GCS assessment work of junior analysts
Assesses GCS-backed application architectures for data leakage

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab GCS assessment methodology; discovers novel GCS attack vectors
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's GCS security assessment methodology
Published research on GCS security bypass techniques or data exfiltration
Trains teams on advanced GCS security assessment

assessment_methods.description: Assess a multi-project GCS environment with intentional misconfigurations and identify all data exposure risks
Review GCS security findings from recent cloud assessment engagements

cis: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v4.0.0 - Section 5 Storage
